title: The Tianji Fragment Appears
next_chapter_hook: As the fragment's light gradually faded, a familiar figure flickered past in the Void—it was Ling Yuan! His gaze met Chen Ji's for a fleeting moment, and the meaning contained within sent a jolt through Chen Ji's heart, as if some long-sealed truth was about to break through the earth.

text.content: When Chen Ji decided to temporarily suppress his rage, he sensed a dormant consciousness deep within the Tianji Record stirring slightly—the Heavenly Eye had noticed his hatred. That intangible gaze was like a frozen cold spring sealed for ten thousand years, bone-chilling, yet carrying a playful taste of examining prey. Chen Ji's expression remained usual, but his heart felt like walking on thin ice, yet his steps never paused for even a fraction. "Senior, it seems this trip to the secret realm will be far more lively than we imagined." He murmured softly to the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms that was heating up, his tone betraying neither joy nor anger, only a cold gleam flickering in the depths of his eyes. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul in the fragment rippled gently, seeming to respond, yet also to warn.

Deep within the secret realm, ancient ruins loomed indistinctly in the blue Spiritual Light. Chen Ji moved through the broken walls and debris, each step crushing thick dust, stirring fine Spiritual Dust. The air carried an indescribable scent—the breath of time, mingled with the unique coolness of ancient Spiritual Energy. Just as he was about to approach the ruins' core, the Tianji Record in his embrace suddenly trembled violently, searing hot that he could barely hold it. "This is..." Chen Ji's brow furrowed. In the next instant, a brilliant golden light erupted from the depths of the ruins, directly tearing apart the secret realm's dark sky. The aura within that light produced a strange resonance with the blood flowing in his veins!

"What!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Within the golden light, a palm-sized fragment slowly emerged, its dense runes moving like living creatures, each pattern emanating a terrifying pressure that shook one's heart. And what shocked Chen Ji most was—the fragment was approaching him! Not attracted by his power, but actively, eagerly flying toward him, like a child lost for years finally finding its way home. The Tianji Record trembled wildly in his embrace, unprecedented excitement and agitation. "Bloodline... it's sensing my bloodline!" Chen Ji understood instantly, his heart couldn't help but pound wildly.

dialogue.content: "Steady yourself!" Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, aged yet carrying a rare gravity. "This fragment is the key piece for karma-tracing abilities. When it was peeled from the complete Tianji Record, it has been searching for a destined person. Your Chen family bloodline is precisely why it recognizes you as its master. But—" Mo Xiansheng paused, his tone shifting, "Before it fully fuses with you, be wary of those who covet it." Before he could finish, an outrageously loud laughter came from the other end of the ruins.

"Hahaha! Right here as expected!" Han Lie's domineering figure emerged from behind the ruins, the Xuanwu Sect's martial intent pressing down like a tangible force. The玄武 shadow coiling around him was vivid and lifelike, each scale gleaming with metallic luster. When he saw the fragment floating in the golden light, his eyes showed undisguised greed. "Tianji Record fragment? Didn't expect this waste to be useful, actually attracting such a treasure!" His gaze fell on Chen Ji, a mocking arc curling at the corner of his mouth. "Chen Ji, considering you led the way, this young master can leave you a whole corpse. Hand over the fragment obediently, perhaps if this young master is in a good mood, I can let you die more comfortably!"

text.content: Chen Ji stood quietly in place, allowing the golden light to flicker across his face. His expression was terrifyingly calm, calmly terrifying. The surrounding atmosphere suddenly thickened, as if an invisible giant hand was plucking the strings of destiny. When Han Lie saw Chen Ji not responding, he laughed even more gleefully. "What? Scared stupid? That's right, a servant disciple probably doesn't even know what the Tianji Record is, right?" He took a step forward, the ground beneath his feet cracking. "Let me tell you, this fragment is a supreme treasure that allows cultivators to trace karma and discern truth! How could something like this befit a废物 like you?"

choice.prompt: The fragment was right before his eyes, Han Lie pressing closer step by step—how would Chen Ji deal with this sudden crisis of plunder?

choices.description: Guide the Chen family bloodline within to resonate with the fragment, accelerating the fusion process, using the fragment's power to intimidate Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Fragment initial fusion, gaining brief power amplification
choices.risk_hint: Fusion may expose more bloodline secrets

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly closed his eyes, forming an ancient hand seal with both hands. In an instant, the bloodline power within him surged like a volcanic eruption, creating a violent resonance with the fragment in the golden light! "You—" Han Lie's face changed drastically. He felt a boundless pressure rising from Chen Ji, a suppression from the depths of his bloodline that forced him to involuntarily step back. The fragment, as if finding its final home, transformed into a stream of light and directly entered Chen Ji's Brow Center!

Intense pain struck, yet Chen Ji gritted his teeth and endured. The information contained within the fragment flooded his mind like a tide—those were annotations left by Chen Xuan, golden characters clearly legible: "Shackles are not locks, but the beginning of trials." At the same time, his bloodline awakening rapidly climbed, leaping from thirty percent directly to fifty percent! The outline of the third page of the Tianji Record also began to appear, blurry yet real. All of this happened between lightning flashes, so fast that Han Lie couldn't react at all. "This... this is impossible!" Han Lie's eyes widened, face full of disbelief.

choices.text: Retreat to Advance, Lure the Enemy Deeper
choices.description: Deliberately show weakness, let Han Lie approach then activate the Tianji Record's foresight ability when he's off guard, counterattack at the optimal moment
choices.visible_reward: Foresee Han Lie's attack trajectory, execute precise counterattack
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie is powerful; any foresight deviation may lead to failure

text.content: A cunning gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, yet his face showed terror. "Han Shaojun, spare my life! I, I will give you the fragment right away..." As he spoke, he made a gesture to reach for the fragment, but his steps stumbled, deliberately revealing a flaw. Han Lie coldly snorted, "Insignificant trick!" His figure flashed, directly pouncing toward the fragment, completely disregarding Chen Ji. Just as he was about to touch the fragment, Chen Ji's mouth curled into a cold smile—the Tianji Record silently activated, foresight ability instantly triggered!

"In three breaths, Han Lie will attack from the left, targeting my neck." Chen Ji's heart was as clear as a mirror. He deliberately tilted his body, "accidentally" bumping into the fragment, instead completely exposing Han Lie's attack within his preset trap. When Han Lie's fist, wrapped in Xuanwu power, whistled toward him, Chen Ji's form was like a specter as he sidestepped, simultaneously slapping the fragment—Ancient Forbidden Formations stored within the fragment were triggered, golden light patterns shooting toward Han Lie like blades! "What!" Han Lie's pupils shrank sharply, hastily blocking with both arms, yet he was sent staggering back several zhang, blood flowing freely from his arms.

choices.text: Borrow Strength to Strike, Introduce a Third Party
choices.description: Exploit Han Lie's greed, trigger the fragment's protective forbidden formations, draw other factions within the secret realm into the chaos
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie was constrained by multiple forces, allowing Chen Ji to escape and complete the fusion
choices.risk_hint: Damage to the fragment may affect subsequent ability awakening

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, and a bold plan formed in his mind. He suddenly sent a stream of spiritual energy toward the fragment while murmuring incantations—the method to activate the forbidden formation he learned from Mo Xiansheng. "Since Young Hero Han wants it so badly, I'll give it to you!" Before the words finished, the runes on the fragment blazed suddenly, and an earth-shattering aura exploded outward! "Madman!" Han Lie's face changed drastically, and he hastily retreated. But it was too late. The shockwave from the triggered formation swept across in all directions, also alerting the other forces lurking within the secret realm.

Deep within the ruins, several figures soared into the sky. From the direction of the Tianqing Sect, sword lights flickered faintly; from the direction of the Demonic Holy Sect, black miasma spread. What terrified Chen Ji most was that in the chaos, he sensed a familiar and dangerous aura—Ling Yuan! The old sect master's gaze was like a venomous snake lurking in the shadows, ready to seize the opportunity. "What a fine case of the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind." Chen Ji coldly sneered in his heart. While everyone's attention was scattered, he quietly activated his bloodline power, drawing the fragment to his side. The fusion began silently.

The moment the fragment sank into his brow center, Chen Ji felt his mind explode with a thunderous roar. Countless images flashed by like a carousel—fragmented memories of the causal tracing ability. Though incomplete, they were enough for him to glimpse the deeper mysteries of the Tianji Record. At the same time, golden text emerged in the depths of his consciousness—annotations left by Chen Xuan. The brushstrokes were powerful and vigorous, yet carried an inexplicable depth of meaning: "Fetters are not locks, but the beginning of trials." Chen Ji repeated these words murmuringly, his heart surging with tumultuous waves. Fetters... could it refer to the bloodline curse upon him? Or the Tianji Record's binding on him? And what did "the beginning of trials" mean?

The sensation of bloodline awakening was like fire consuming the body, or ice piercing the bones. Chen Ji felt the Chen family bloodline within him boiling, roaring, and rushing through every inch of his meridians at an unbelievable speed. The awakening degree climbed from thirty percent to forty, then to fifty—this already exceeded Chen Ji's previous limit! The outline of the third page of the Tianji Record gradually became clear in his consciousness—a web covered with causal threads, each thread connecting to different nodes of destiny. "So this is the causal tracing ability..." Chen Ji murmured, his eyes flickering with brilliant light. With this ability, he might be able to trace deliberately concealed truths, and even... find his sister Chen Nian!

dialogue.content: "Despicable!" Han Lie steadied himself, gazing at the golden light coiling around Chen Ji, his eyes full of disbelief and towering fury. His arms were still bleeding, and obvious cracks had appeared on his Xuanwu Battle Body—he was in a wretched state. "A waste like you, how could—" Mid-sentence, he suddenly sensed something, his expression changing drastically. From all directions of the secret realm, powerful auras were approaching. Han Lie gritted his teeth, casting one final venomous look at Chen Ji. "Chen Ji! Remember this! Today's humiliation, I shall repay a hundredfold!" With that, he actually turned and fled into the depths of the ruins, clearly not daring to stay, fearful of the other forces' encirclement.

text.content: Watching Han Lie's狼狈 retreating figure, a faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. "Repay a hundredfold?" he said softly, his tone full of playful mockery. "Young Hero Han, losing to a waste today, you'll probably be laughed at by your fellow disciples when you return. The title of the Tianqing Sect's number one genius might have to be changed to 'the biggest joke.'" Though spoken softly, these words were perfectly audible to Han Lie. The latter's form visibly stiffened, nearly spitting blood in anger, but ultimately gritted his teeth and left, not daring to linger. Chen Ji watched him vanish into the ruins, his smile gradually fading, replaced by deep contemplation.

choice.prompt: Han Lie has retreated, but undercurrents surge within the secret realm. How should Chen Ji deal with this newly acquired fragment and abilities?

choices.text: Immediately enter closed-door meditation to thoroughly fuse
choices.description: Find a concealed place to completely integrate the fragment into the Tianji Record, stabilizing the newly acquired abilities
choices.visible_reward: Causal tracing ability initially mastered, bloodline awakening stabilized
choices.risk_hint: Risk of attacks during closed-door meditation

text.content: Chen Ji acted decisively, his form flashing as he dove into a fissure deep within the ruins. This fissure was extremely concealed—without the causal perception ability he had just gained during the fragment fusion, it would have been impossible to discover. The fissure contained an unexpected space: a meditation chamber left from ancient times. Though simple, traces of an aura-isolating formation remained. Chen Ji sat cross-legged and began to fuse the fragment with all his might. The causal power within the fragment perfectly matched his bloodline, like old friends reuniting after a long separation, merging without any resistance.

During the fusion process, Chen Ji's consciousness entered a strange space. It was filled with causal threads, each representing a different possibility. He reached out to touch one thread, and the scene before his eyes changed abruptly—he saw a blurry figure, imprisoned within endless darkness. "Niannian!" Chen Ji's heart jolted. It was his sister Chen Nian! Though the image vanished in an instant, it was enough to prove that Chen Nian was still alive, and in some place related to "darkness"! When Chen Ji awoke from the fusion, there was an unnoticeable determination deep within his eyes.

choices.text: Pursue Ling Yuan while the iron is hot
choices.description: Use the newly acquired causal perception ability to attempt tracking the old sect master Ling Yuan's trail
choices.visible_reward: May discover the connection between Ling Yuan and the Chen family bloodline
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's strength is profound and unfathomable; rashly tracking may expose oneself

text.content: The causal perception brought by the fragment fusion still reverberated within Chen Ji's body, and he did not waste this opportunity. He closed his eyes, immersing his consciousness into the causal web of the Tianji Record's third page. "Ling Yuan..." he silently chanted the old sect master's name while activating the newly acquired tracing ability. A thread finer than a filament appeared in his consciousness, winding and curving toward the depths of the ruins. But during the tracking process, he discovered something that made his blood run cold—the causal thread between himself and Ling Yuan actually presented an eerie red color!

result_nodes.text: Observe quietly and wait for the enemy to arrive
result_nodes.description: The commotion caused by the fragment fusion will inevitably attract various forces; better to rest and wait for the enemy
result_nodes.visible_reward: can sit on the mountaintop watching tigers fight, reaping the fisherman's profit
result_nodes.risk_hint: may fall into a chaotic multi-party battle

text.content: Chen Ji did not hurry to leave. Instead, he found a commanding height, concealed his aura, and observed quietly. As expected, before long, figures appeared from all directions of the ruins. First came the patrol disciples of Tianqing Sect, rushing over in haste, their faces blank at the devastated battlefield. Next were several black-clad figures from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, their aura cold and eerie. Finally, an elderly man with white hair appeared—it was Ling Yuan!

Ling Yuan stood in the center of the ruins, his withered hand gently stroking the residual golden light traces on the ground. A flash of sharpness crossed his murky old eyes, followed by a meaningful laugh toward the sky: 'A fragment of the Tianji Record... heh, it seems I didn't find the wrong person all those years ago.' His gaze swept toward the direction where Chen Ji was hiding, 'Little one, come out. I know you're here.' Chen Ji's heart tightened, but he didn't immediately reveal himself. He acutely sensed that Ling Yuan's words held deeper meaning—what did 'didn't find the wrong person' mean? Could the former Sect Master have known his identity from the start?

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, a meaningful smile appearing on his aged face. His gaze seemed to penetrate the void, precisely locking onto Chen Ji's position. 'What, afraid to come out?' The old Sect Master's tone carried a hint of mockery, 'Indeed, with your current strength, you truly have no power to resist before me. However—' His voice turned sharp, 'The bloodline flowing through you is what interests me greatly. The Chen family... heh, I never expected that lineage to still exist.' The atmosphere in the ruins froze abruptly, Ling Yuan's words like a blade piercing the most hidden corner of Chen Ji's heart.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly walked out from his hiding place, his expression still calm, as if Ling Yuan's words had no effect on him. But in his heart, monstrous waves were churning—Ling Yuan indeed knew of the Chen family's existence! And from his words, it seemed there was some unknown connection between them. 'What does Senior mean by that?' Chen Ji's voice carried no emotional fluctuation, 'This junior is merely a servant disciple, knowing nothing about any Chen family.' Upon hearing this, Ling Yuan didn't get angry; instead, he laughed even more heartily. 'How convenient, knowing nothing.' He slowly walked toward Chen Ji, each step pressing on the threads of karma, causing the space to tremble slightly, 'But the aura of that bloodline in you speaks truer than any words.'

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to this sudden bloodline interrogation as Ling Yuan presses closer with veiled words?

choices.text: Play the fool and retreat to advance
choices.description: Continue pretending to know nothing, using feigned weakness to probe how much Ling Yuan knows
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the relationship between the Chen family and Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may see through the disguise

text.content: 'Senior is joking.' Chen Ji slightly bowed, assuming a respectful appearance, 'This junior truly doesn't know of any special bloodline within him. If Senior knows, please enlighten me.' Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, his scrutinizing gaze like a blade sweeping back and forth over Chen Ji. After a long while, he suddenly let out a sneer: 'Playing the part quite well. But the aura of that bloodline in you, I will never mistake.' He paused, a complex light flickering in his eyes, 'Very well, since you won't speak, I'll pretend you know nothing.'

choices.text: Fierce confrontation, fighting with one's life
choices.description: Drop the disguise entirely, directly question Ling Yuan's relationship with the Chen family, showing a tough stance
choices.visible_reward: May force out the truth from Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: Enormous gap in strength, possible life-threatening danger

text.content: 'Since Senior knows of the Chen family, I assume you had dealings with my ancestors?' Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned cold, the timidity in his eyes swept away, replaced by a chilling edge, 'I wonder, is Senior friend or foe to the Chen family?' Ling Yuan was stunned, then burst into hearty laughter: 'Good! Good one,废物 disciple!' His laughter stopped abruptly, his eyes blazing with brilliant light, 'Since you want to know, I'll tell you—when the Tianji Record's inheritance was contested, that old thing Chen Xuan chose your Chen bloodline instead of me!'

Ling Yuan's words were like thunderclap exploding in Chen Ji's mind. The contest for the Tianji Record's inheritance? The grudge between Chen Xuan and Ling Yuan? What secrets lay hidden within all this? Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the shock in his heart, maintaining his composure on the surface. 'So Senior's meaning is... you harbor resentment toward the Chen family?' Ling Yuan did not answer, merely looking at him with profound meaning, the complex emotions in his gaze unfathomable—there was hatred, resentment, but more importantly, an inexplicable anticipation. 'Little one, you still have many secrets.' The old Sect Master slowly turned around, 'But I have no intention of killing you yet. The karmic connection between us... is far deeper than you imagine.' With that, his figure actually faded within the golden light, as if he had never appeared.

After Ling Yuan departed, an eerie silence fell over the ruins. Chen Ji stood alone, his mind racing with countless thoughts. 'Fetters are not truly fetters, but the beginning of trials'—Chen Xuan's annotation echoed in his mind. Ling Yuan harbored resentment due to losing the inheritance, yet the Chen family obtained the Tianji Record's legacy. Who could say where the right and wrong lay in all this? 'Senior.' Chen Ji murmured softly, 'What truly happened with the Tianji Record's inheritance back then?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rippled within the fragment, but did not answer directly, only saying meaningfully: 'Some truths, you must seek yourself. But remember—fetters can be bondage, or they can be strength. The key lies in how you view them.'

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his own hands, where a faint golden pattern was faintly visible beneath the skin—the mark of bloodline awakening. He could clearly feel the Chen family bloodline flowing within him awakening in an unprecedented way. Bloodline awakened by fifty percent, the third page of the Tianji Record initially taking shape, the ability to trace karma preliminarily mastered... this trip to the secret realm yielded far more than expected. But at the same time, more mysteries surfaced—the grudge between the Chen family and Ling Yuan, the secret of the Tianji Record's inheritance, and that figure glimpsed fleetingly in the fragment's light... Chen Ji took a deep breath, a firm light flickering in his eyes. No matter how arduous the road ahead, he would walk it step by step. Because he understood that only by becoming strong enough could he protect those he wished to protect, only then could he uncover those truths deliberately buried. Above the ruins, the golden light gradually faded, but Chen Ji's story had only just begun.
